'''Sabodor's''' was a purveyor of exotic pets. It was located on [[Etti IV]].<ref name="TFAICS" />

[[Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca]]'s [[bulk freighter]], the ''[[Eravana]]'', included a container that hosted a [[veterinary droid]] which tended to exotic pets acquired at Sabodor's.<ref name="TFAICS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Sabodor's was created in the [[Star Wars Legends|Legends]] novel ''[[Han Solo at Stars' End]]'', written by Brian Daley. Its existence and presence on Etti IV was introduced to the current [[canon]] in ''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: Incredible Cross-Sections]]'', published in [[2015]].
